items.prose: Under its own massive dead weight, the 50mm virgin lead slab has sagged forty millimeters downward over four years, tearing through the upper brass anchor bolts. A two-inch gap opened at the ceiling header, allowing direct gamma shine into the main telephone switch room.

Intense fast-neutron bombardment over seven years induced lattice displacement cascades within the lead shielding blocks. The metal has swelled 6% in volume, developing sponge-like macroscopic blisters that cracked the surrounding reinforced concrete encasement.

Sulfuric acid fumes from overcharged stationary lead-acid batteries reacted with the wall cladding, converting the outer eight millimeters of dense lead sheet into crumbly white lead sulfate powder. Sweeping crews removed three wheelbarrows of toxic white dust from the floor perimeter.

Groundwater hydrostatic pressure behind the lead lining leached free calcium hydroxide from the concrete back-wall, creating hollow voids behind the metal skin. Tapping the lead face with a wooden mallet produces deep hollow booming across sixteen square meters.

Shock reflection from a high-yield surface impact caused internal tensile spallation across the rear face of the lead barrier. Lead counter-bore plugs were ejected from their recesses like bullets, leaving sixty unshielded 30mm bolt holes piercing directly through the barrier.

Unsupervised dwellers chiseled out two hundred and forty kilograms of sheet lead from the dark archive corridor to cast fishing weights, bullets, and radiation chalices for the Cobalt Flame cult. A eight-meter horizontal section of concrete wall was left completely unshielded.

Alternating cycles of 120°C exhaust gas and freezing winter standby caused massive 'oil-can' buckling across the welded lead seams. Repeated flexing fractured the lead-tin solder joints, allowing radioactive chimney soot to blow directly into the adjacent ventilation shafts.
